ValidationRule.description: MR-119 T3 / MR-120 2.1–2.3: Closed Won needs a synced quote that is Approved and Presented to the customer.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), OR(ISBLANK(SyncedQuoteId), NOT(OR(ISPICKVAL(SyncedQuote.Status, "Presented"), ISPICKVAL(SyncedQuote.Status, "Accepted")))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sync a quote, get it approved and present it to the customer before closing this opportunity as won.
